Very good food, not much atmosphere
Jan 2026 • Couples
My husband and I ate lunch here as a part of a tour group. It appeared that most everyone else in the restaurant was also with a group, which is always disappointing to me. I prefer to eat at a place frequented by local people. Our meal was very good, though. The spring rolls were excellent, as were the pork meatballs and sea bass. I recommend going as long as you are okay with it being kind of a tourist spot.
